title: Following the Error Through a Compressed Network:An Angular Measure for FFN Weight Compression in ViT-L/16
abstract: arXiv:2611.28067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the compression of the 48 feed-forward network (FFN) matrices of the Vision Transformer ViT-L/16 to 2--8 bits with four schemes: a per-token grid, a fixed Gaussian Lloyd--Max table, a table fitted to the matrix, and a random-sign Hadamard rotation followed by the fixed table. We evaluate on 50,000 images. At 4 bits the top-1 accuracy of the four schemes lies within 0.8 points of the float32 model, while the agreement with its predictions ranges from 98.4\% to 94.4\%. We use the angular error between the compressed and the float32 residual stream, followed through the blocks, as a portable measure that ranks the schemes as the final classification does and shows where the ranking is built: with rotation the angle grows close to the square root of the number of blocks, the signature of independently accumulating errors, while the other schemes are amplified in the later blocks. translated_title: 追踪压缩网络中的误差：ViT-L/16中FFN权重压缩的角度度量
translated_abstract: 我们研究了Vision Transformer ViT-L/16的48个前馈网络（FFN）矩阵压缩到2-8比特的四种方案：逐token网格、固定的高斯Lloyd-Max量化表、针对矩阵拟合的量化表，以及随机符号Hadamard旋转后接固定表。我们在50,000张图像上进行评估。在4比特下，四种方案的top-1准确率与float32模型相差在0.8个百分点以内，而与其预测结果的一致性范围从98.4%到94.4%。我们使用压缩模型与float32模型残差流之间的角度误差（沿各网络块逐层追踪）作为一种可移植的度量，该度量对各种方案的排序与最终分类结果一致，并揭示了排序是在何处形成的：使用旋转时，角度随块数的增长接近平方根关系，这是误差独立累积的标志，而其他方案则在后期的网络块中被放大。同样的度量还表明，某种表现更好的方案……
tldr: 本文提出用压缩模型与float32模型残差流之间的角度误差作为可移植度量，用于评估ViT-L/16中FFN权重量化方案，该度量不仅能预测最终分类性能的排序，还能揭示误差如何随网络深度累积。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the angular error between compressed and float32 residual streams, traced through network blocks, as a portable measure for ranking FFN weight compression schemes in ViT-L/16, which predicts final classification rankings and reveals how errors accumulate with network depth.
